sce.cmd.clone_failed: No cached JSON for %s to clone from.
sce.msg.not_editable: %s was written by a script (KubeJS, CraftTweaker or similar), not as a recipe file. The script rewrites it every time the pack loads, so an edit here would not last. Change it in the script instead.
sce.cmd.debug_status: Recipes in the game right now: %s. Recipes read from the datapacks: %s. Of those, the pack's own recipes we rebuild from: %s.
sce.cmd.debug_help: Turn on with /sce debug true, or one area at a time: reload (recipes loading), edit (creating and saving), network (client/server messages), compat (other recipe mods), permission (who may edit), client (keys and screens), perf (how long the mod's own work takes). Everything is written to latest.log with the [SCE-DBG] prefix. /sce debug perf on its own prints what has been timed; /sce debug perf reset starts a fresh measurement.
